context: Request: the full set of the firm's Capital Markets offerings that used a 180-day lock-up, with the documents showing each lock-up. Rubric: 1010-00002 (Arbor Health IPO) and 1037-00001 (Solstice Biomedical IPO) with their lock-up forms, plus precision; 1018-00001 (Penterra, a shelf secondary with a new 90-day lock-up) is not permitted.

stages.note: Opened and closed with no tool call; the agent switches to text extraction, the stage the note named.

stages.note: declared: new: Aggregate scan report per matter. Per-matter term flags from the saved report; nearly every matter is flagged, seven are picked by hand.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: new: Tighten per-matter lock-up scan. A proximity filter on the saved report, then a document-level extraction rerun over the store (48 documents, 9 matters) and an offering-file-name listing per matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Underwriting and lock-up agreements of eight candidates, then withdrawal, dormancy and closing papers; one guessed path fails. A secondary-offering matter is read through its execution agreement and a waiver memo. End label note: Screen candidate matters by reading documents; the next screening was declared under a new name.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes six matters: three completed offerings (including the secondary-offering matter) and three withdrawn, dormant or prospective ones. The review flags the three non-completed matters as inflating the set.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the headline to count only the three completed offerings and moves the other three to a non-counted section; checks cited paths.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads six sources. The review flags that the secondary-offering matter is kept on an earlier deal's term that was never opened. End label note: Screen candidate matters by reading documents; the run then finishes.

stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: Mixed (T2 passes; T0, T1 fail on precision). All three runs found and read both qualifying offerings and the secondary-offering matter's documents. They split at the write stage: T0 and T1 counted the secondary-offering matter as a completed 180-day offering through its earlier deal's term; T2 read the same new lock-up agreement and closing memo and kept the matter as a near miss. Reviews differed: T0's final check review named the matter's weak basis (ignored), T1's reviews only pushed to separate completed from non-closing deals, and T2's check review warned not to add matters on weak grounds. Neither a label note nor an agent-declared stage played a part in the split.
